title: Exact Reformulation and Optimization for Direct Metric Optimization in Binary Imbalanced Classification
abstract: arXiv:2507.15240v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: For classification with imbalanced class frequencies, i.e., imbalanced classification (IC), standard accuracy is known to be misleading as a performance measure. While most existing methods for IC resort to optimizing balanced accuracy (i.e., the average of class-wise recalls), they fall short in scenarios where the significance of classes varies or certain metrics should reach prescribed levels. In this paper, we study two key classification metrics, precision and recall, under three practical binary IC settings: fix precision optimize recall (FPOR), fix recall optimize precision (FROP), and optimize $F_1$-score (OFOS). Unlike existing methods that rely on smooth approximations to deal with the indicator function involved, we introduce, for the first time, exact constrained reformulations for these direct metric optimization (DMO) problems, which can be effectively solved by exact penalty methods. translated_title: 二分类不平衡分类中直接指标优化的精确重构与优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.15240v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：对于类别频率不平衡的分类问题（即不平衡分类，IC），标准准确率作为性能度量已知具有误导性。虽然大多数现有的IC方法依赖于优化平衡准确率（即类别召回率的平均值），但在类别重要性不同或某些指标需达到预设水平的情况下，这些方法表现不足。本文研究了两个关键分类指标——精确率和召回率，在三种实际二分类IC设置下：固定精确率优化召回率（FPOR）、固定召回率优化精确率（FROP）以及优化$F_1$分数（OFOS）。与现有依赖平滑近似处理指示函数的方法不同，我们首次为这些直接指标优化（DMO）问题引入了精确的约束重构，这些重构可以通过精确罚方法有效求解。在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明了其有效性。
tldr: 本文首次为二分类不平衡分类中的直接指标优化问题（如固定精确率优化召回率、固定召回率优化精确率及优化F1分数）提出了精确的约束重构方法，避免了传统平滑近似，并通过精确罚方法高效求解。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces, for the first time, exact constrained reformulations for direct metric optimization problems in binary imbalanced classification (e.g., FPOR, FROP, and OFOS), avoiding smooth approximations and enabling efficient solving via exact penalty methods.
